name: Snowfall
source:
In a remote village surrounded by monsters, a pair of lovers stand guard. But the cold is a dangerous thing, and the monsters even worse.

[From [url=https://rodfireproductions.itch.io/snowfall]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个被怪物包围的偏远村庄里，一对恋人站岗。但寒冷是一件危险的事情，而怪物则更危险。

[来自[url=https://rodfireproductions.itch.io/snowfall]Itch.io[/url]]
